name: Folded Swift
productConnection: A quick paper swift carries an idea from sketch to shipped web product, joining Albert's design and engineering practice.
silhouette: A wide A-like folded wing span, rounded triangular head, compact body, tiny feet, and one broad Z-notched tail plane.
signatureFeature: One wing fold creates an open A-shaped negative space while the tail turns through a single Z-shaped zigzag.
appealHook: The right wing tip curls upward like the corner of a page that is ready to be turned.

name: Type Sprout
productConnection: A living ink sprout represents ideas growing through writing, typography, and code.
silhouette: A low rounded ink seed with two oversized paper leaves and two short feet.
signatureFeature: The two leaves meet as an A-shaped opening and a single stem bends like the diagonal of a Z.
appealHook: One leaf is always slightly too large, giving the tiny character a curious lean.

name: Orbit Beetle
productConnection: A compact maker beetle collects small observations and turns them into connected experiments.
silhouette: A domed oval shell, tiny rounded head, four short leg masses, and a clean split wing case.
signatureFeature: The shell opens into an A-shaped seam with one broad Z-shaped path crossing the wing cases.
appealHook: Its shell tilts forward when it concentrates, like a designer leaning over a sketchbook.
